scenarios.title: A｜提醒付款
scenarios.setting: 已经到了交房租的日期，但室友还没有把自己的那部分转给玩家。

turns.prompt: 你想提醒室友到了交房租的时间，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hey, just a reminder that rent is due today.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, just a reminder that rent is due today.
feedback.explanation: “just a reminder”轻轻提醒一件已知事项，常用于约定日期或付款期限。

choices.text: Have you had a chance to send your share of the rent yet?

feedback.naturalExpression: Have you had a chance to send your share of the rent yet?
feedback.explanation: “have you had a chance to”询问对方是否已有机会处理，比直接追问为什么没做更柔和。

choices.text: Hey, I haven’t received your part of the rent yet.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, I haven’t received your part of the rent yet.
feedback.explanation: “I haven’t received”表示到现在仍未收到，适合查询邮件、物品或办理结果。

choices.text: Could you send me your share of the rent today?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you send me your share of the rent today?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Did you pay the house money?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, just a reminder that rent is due today.
feedback.explanation: 房租直接叫“rent”；“house money”不能准确表达这一款项。

turns.text: Oh, I completely forgot. I’ll send it tonight.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay, thanks. I just need to make the full payment tomorrow.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, thanks. I just need to make the full payment tomorrow.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: No problem. Just send it over when you get home.

feedback.naturalExpression: No problem. Just send it over when you get home.
feedback.explanation: 用简短回应表示不介意或愿意体谅，可以减轻对方的歉意。

choices.text: Great. Let me know once you’ve sent it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Let me know once you’ve sent it.
feedback.explanation: “Let me …”提出由自己来做下一步，能明确谁来采取行动。

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Appreciate it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Appreciate it.
feedback.explanation: “appreciate it”是简短感谢，“it”指对方刚提供的帮助。

scenarios.title: B｜询问原因
scenarios.setting: 第二天，室友仍然没有付款。

turns.prompt: 关于「室友拖欠房租」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hey, I still haven’t received the rent. Is everything okay?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, I still haven’t received the rent. Is everything okay?
feedback.explanation: “haven’t”与过去分词搭配说明截至现在仍未完成的事，方便对方判断当前进度。

choices.text: You said you’d send the rent yesterday. Did something happen?

feedback.naturalExpression: You said you’d send the rent yesterday. Did something happen?
feedback.explanation: “did something happen”先询问是否有事情发生，避免直接把计划变化归结为对方故意不配合。

choices.text: Is there a reason you haven’t been able to pay your share yet?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there a reason you haven’t been able to pay your share yet?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: If there’s a problem with the rent this month, I’d rather you tell me.

feedback.naturalExpression: If there’s a problem with the rent this month, I’d rather you tell me.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

turns.text: Yeah. I’m sorry. I’m a little short on money this month.

turns.prompt: 你想了解这项服务的费用，会怎么问？

choices.text: Okay. How much are you short?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. How much are you short?
feedback.explanation: “How much”可问金额或不可数事物的量；这里把所需数额直接作为问题重点。

choices.text: I understand. When do you think you’ll be able to pay it?

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand. When do you think you’ll be able to pay it?
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: Thanks for telling me. I just wish you’d mentioned it earlier.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks for telling me. I just wish you’d mentioned it earlier.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Is this just a temporary problem, or do you think next month will be difficult too?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is this just a temporary problem, or do you think next month will be difficult too?
feedback.explanation: 把两种可能列出来请对方确认，适合核对自己拿不准的细节。

turns.text: I get paid next Friday. I should be able to pay everything then.

turns.prompt: 关于「室友拖欠房租」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: Okay. I need to know because the rent still has to be paid on time.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I need to know because the rent still has to be paid on time.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: All right. Let’s figure out what we can do until Friday.

feedback.naturalExpression: All right. Let’s figure out what we can do until Friday.
feedback.explanation: “figure out”表示想明白或弄清楚，强调经过思考找到办法。

choices.text: Okay, but please tell me earlier next time if you know you’re going to be late.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, but please tell me earlier next time if you know you’re going to be late.
feedback.explanation: “next time”把可能的参与留到下次，适合婉拒当下的邀请。

scenarios.title: C｜讨论之后怎么办
scenarios.setting: 在“室友拖欠房租”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“讨论之后怎么办”。

turns.text: I’m really sorry. I don’t want you to have to cover my rent.

turns.prompt: 关于「室友拖欠房租」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: I can cover it this time, but I can’t do that every month.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can cover it this time, but I can’t do that every month.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: We need a plan so this doesn’t become a regular problem.

feedback.naturalExpression: We need a plan so this doesn’t become a regular problem.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: If you’re going to be late with rent, I need to know before the due date.

feedback.naturalExpression: If you’re going to be late with rent, I need to know before the due date.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: We should probably talk about what happens if you can’t pay on time again.

feedback.naturalExpression: We should probably talk about what happens if you can’t pay on time again.
feedback.explanation: 问清后续处理或结果，能在行动前了解可能的影响。

turns.text: I understand. I think this month was just unusually bad.

turns.prompt: 关于「室友拖欠房租」，你想提出一个接下来的做法或安排，会怎么建议？

choices.text: Okay. Then let’s agree that you’ll pay me back next Friday.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Then let’s agree that you’ll pay me back next Friday.
feedback.explanation: “pay me back”表示还钱，“back”明确是归还之前借出的款项。

choices.text: That’s fine, but I need you to stick to that date.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fine, but I need you to stick to that date.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: If it happens again, we may need to reconsider our living arrangement.

feedback.naturalExpression: If it happens again, we may need to reconsider our living arrangement.
feedback.explanation: “reconsider”表示重新考虑，说明现有安排可能需要调整。

choices.text: I don’t want money problems to turn into problems between us, so let’s be clear about expectations now.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t want money problems to turn into problems between us, so let’s be clear about expectations now.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

turns.text: That’s fair. I’ll pay you as soon as I get paid.

turns.prompt: 关于「室友拖欠房租」，你想提出一个接下来的做法或安排，会怎么建议？

choices.text: Okay. Let’s stick to that plan.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Let’s stick to that plan.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: Great. And please give me a heads-up earlier if there’s ever a problem again.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. And please give me a heads-up earlier if there’s ever a problem again.
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。
